items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: When Sid and I played together... we'd always work with the cornet... we had little things worked up together... head arrangements.

ctx.x: Yeah. You played sax some, but you played clarinet mostly. Mostly clarinet.

Yeah. I played the baritone too then with Brownlee. But then when I joined Sharky, or rather rejoined Sharky, I played the tenor. Oh. Because he used Sidney Aragon, who played nothing but the clarinet.
Can you tell us anything about him? I never got to meet him. Sidney? Raymond talks a lot about him, but...
